source: Maps and notes in our own words, following the KASNEB CPA paper list (kasneb.or.ke/cpa, checked 14 Oct 2026); standards named (IFRS, IAS, ISA, IPSAS) but never quoted; videos link to YouTube. parts.title: Step 1 · CPA Foundation
parts.subtitle: Start here. Six papers, CA11 to CA16. No accounting knowledge needed.

parts.title: Step 2 · CPA Intermediate
parts.subtitle: Six papers, CA21 to CA26: company law, finance, reporting, audit, management accounting, tax.

parts.title: Step 3 · CPA Advanced
parts.subtitle: Four compulsory papers (CA31, CA32, CA33, CA34S3) and at least one specialisation (CA34S1, CA34S2 or CA34S4).

parts.title: At work · Accounting in Kenya
parts.subtitle: For people already working: iTax, eTIMS, payroll, Excel, software, month-end.

nodeData.note: New to accounting? Start at Step 1 → CA11 Financial Accounting → 1. What accounting is. Then go in order: each paper is numbered the way KASNEB numbers it (CA11, CA12 … CA34), and each topic inside is numbered 1, 2, 3. Every map has worked examples in KES, flashcards, exam practice and videos. Already working? Open 'At work'. New maps are added every day.
